messages:
maria: Heads-up — production 5xx spike immediately following a canary push (deploy sha: sha1234). Customer support already seeing billing errors + timeouts. Paging SRE. :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: alert: gateway-5xx-rate ↑ (A-9876). Triggers: 5xx > 3x baseline for last 2m.

jay (support): +1 from support queue. Several customers reporting 502 with small payloads. Example request: `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` -> HTTP/1.1 502

cheng: Can someone post the canary config/flags for this release? I want to check any global flags that may have been mis-scoped.

maria: Deploy link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/sha1234 
Canary config excerpt: `feature: adaptive_batching: true`, `batching_window_ms: 0`, `routing.policy: seed-weighted`

alyssa: Who flipped `batching_window_ms` to 0? That would kill batching heuristics and may overload the per-request path. @cheng can you grep the logs for `batching_window_ms` or `batch-window=0` traces?

cheng: grep shows config applied at canary-agent: `applied config batching_window_ms=0 scope=global` — looks like scope was global not canary. Found in orch change: PR #4821.

luca: Repro from my laptop: repeated small requests -> gateway 502 after ~20 concurrent connections. Quick log snippet from gateway: ```
ERROR gateway/handler.go:234 upstream call failed: connection reset by peer
WARN runtime/serve.go:112 model-serving returned 500: runtime OOM for sequence length 8
```

jay (support): Customers also report tokenization billing spikes around the same window. Might be double-counting retries.

cheng: Root hypothesis: global batching_window_ms=0 on canary path removed batching -> increased token churn -> upstream model-serving containers hit memory pressure -> 5xx. Also routing.policy seed-weighted pushed some traffic to canary instances.

alyssa: Action plan: 1) Pause canary rollout and scale down canary traffic to 0. 2) Rollback to previous config (pre-PR #4821). 3) Notify customers and track errors. I can handle rollback.

maria: @alyssa please coordinate with deploy-bot to freeze the rollout. Support: draft a short customer note.

deploy-bot: Received command: `pause-rollout sha1234` by alyssa at 1776543238. Canary weight set to 0%.

alyssa: Executed rollback command: `orch rollback --to=sha1229 --component=canary` (running).

cheng: I'll instrument a quick metric for batching window and model-serving OOMs. Also will prepare a postmortem section re: config scoping.

luca: Confirming: after rollback starting at 1776543248 I see 5xx rate trending down. Baseline restored by ~1776543265.

jay (support): Customer message queued: "We're investigating increased 502s after a recent change; we've paused the rollout and errors are subsiding. We'll follow up with root cause and remediation." :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks team. Next steps: write a short runbook update to prevent global-scoped config flips during canaries and add a CI check on PRs that change runtime flags. @cheng please own the CL.

alyssa: Will open hotfix PR to add validation and follow-up rollback postmortem.

maria: Incident notes: cause = mis-scoped batching flag applied globally in canary, effect = removal of batching -> upstream pressure -> 5xx surge. Mitigation = paused canary + rollback. Posting final numbers to incident tracker.

oncall-bot: Incident A-9876 resolved (status: mitigated) at 1776543275.
